submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 with a 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.386% at the allocated 8 kHz rate. This represents a significant improvement over the other candidates: Algorithm-L3 peaks at 84.958% (at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L1 peaks at 74.078% (at 35 GeV). The iterative topological clustering with learned calibration approach provides superior signal-to-background discrimination, enabling optimal performance at the allocated rate. Through systematic scanning of thresholds from 20-60 GeV, the 40 GeV threshold was identified as optimal, with efficiency declining at both lower and higher thresholds.
